purpose: After LE SC pairing, observe the persisted bond, disconnect, and reconnect with the retained LTK (no SMP). Compare stock vs OpenCFW full-1926.

storage.bond_location: internal MRAM bond table at 0x7FF000 (offset 0x3FF000 in a 4 MiB dump from 0x400000); 10 x 256-byte records, 200-byte payload. Identity 123456789abc00 (peer LE address + type).
storage.nor: external 32 MiB mspi1.nor is unchanged through pair/disconnect/reconnect (sha256 4049ca4e899c7d069573bc4ca86e57c8b00f4b6564de5f2f8e9c9f983610758e, same as post-boot match NOR). The earlier 'NOR bond diff' found no delta because bonds are not stored there.
storage.ram_table_0x20068420: dump succeeded but no 200-byte record at that canonical address on this stock/OpenCFW image; MRAM table is the evidence.

protocol.pair: complete, DHKey verified, AES-CCM authenticated, same LTK sha256 0a91cfb9e3be248056b45375b858cad46d81c7756b3822d760ebef379b23d004
protocol.reconnect: ConnectPeer new handle 2, ATT MTU 247, BeginPeerEncryption with retained LTK, no SMP. EncryptedConnectionCount=1, LastEncryptionStatus=0 on both images. Then CCCD write 0x0845 and app-auth Write Command; both returned ack payload 080410641a00.

programmed_words_after_pair.note: counts differ (OpenCFW boot programs more) but the bond record bytes match

timing_differences: OpenCFW defers the post-pair ATT Read By Group Type (060100ffff00280118) past the official 0.03s poll; this run answered it in a pre-disconnect drain. Stock sends it during/just after SMP.
After LTK reconnect, OpenCFW did not emit that discovery within 2s; stock does immediately. LTK auth and the subsequent CCCD+auth path still succeeded. Not treated as a C mismatch.
notes: Stock completed 20:32 America/Chicago; OpenCFW resumed 20:35 after GATT-timing harness adjustments. Emulator repo and sources.json were not modified in this step (sources.json writer already closed).
